CustDbPath

public static java.lang.String CustDbPath(java.lang.String productName)
Gets the fully qualified file path to a custom product database.
Parameters:
productName - the name of the product as seen in the Windows Registry eg. SOFTWARE\WE-CIM\CustomProduct\PanelFront<\b>\Database

IntGet

public static int IntGet(java.lang.String key,
                         java.lang.String subkey)
Gets the value of the named registry entry as an integer value.
Parameters:
key - Microsoft registry key (folder as seen via Regedit.exe)
subkey - the subkey name (use "" for the default subkey)

IntPut

Sets the value of the named registry entry as a string value.
Parameters:
key - Microsoft registry key (folder as seen via Regedit.exe)
subkey - the subkey name (use "" for the default subkey)
val - the integer value to be recorded in the registry
